name: Ursal the Mauler

comments.body:
The best way to do this is to go down to the SW corner (look on the map it is as close in the bottom left corner as it can be).

Walk a little bit up north (like an cm on your map). Find the pink flashing tree (you will know what i mean when you see it). This tree is right outside the main enterance to the camp.

Just to the right for the main enterance (west from the pink glowing tree) there is a small path that leads uphill. Follow this path and you will end up in the corner of the camp where Mauler is located. You do need to kill approx. 5 mobs before Mauler, but these are easy pullable one and one.

Then kill Mauler! 

BE AWARE: This path is ONE WAY only! You are not able to take the same way out so be prepared with your stone for transportation to your home inn.
Location 38, 79

To find Ursal go SW like the quest says, past the two camps you probably already know about (one in a cave, two on hill sides) keep heading south around the mountains almost to the lake.  Look for a tree with lots of purple around it.  Follow a path that goes up into the hills.  Ursal's camp is up there.

Ursal is a big giant bear in the very southwest corner of the map.  He is protected by many, many Gnarlpines levels ~9-12? 

We could have done it much sooner than we did.  A Rouge 13 and preist 12 made short work of Ursal and the 3 or 4 links.

comments.body: u dont need to kill 100 dudes to get to ursal. Just take the path to the hills (with trees and bushes in it) Then u only need to pull 4 guys or so and then u can pull ursal. It wasnt easy with lvl 10 rogue but possible.

Coming straight out of Darnassus, head due south where the path begins to go north. Before this bend, the path will be going west. Continue south (you might have to fight moonstalkers and some spiders) until you reach the lake. There you will find a camp of furlbogs. Ignore it. Keep going. There will be more camps along the way. When you come to the tree surrounded by pink, the Glowing Fruit Tree, (its pretty far south) look straight east. You  will see a ravine type thing with trees in it. There is a spider in front of it. It doesnt look like much but you must follow it. This will put you in the back of the camp. You will have to kill a few pathfinders and maybe a totmic. The guy you have to kill, Ursal, is the only black one. Wait in the ravine until he's close. He walks in circles and will stop breifly in front of the ravine. Pull him in. He is a level 12. I was level 11, warlock, when I did this. I died once but came back with more spells and buffs. That time, I got him. Good Luck. Once you kill him you can't go back up into the ravine. You will have to fight your way out.

I took this guy out easy at lvl 11. Sneak back in the corner kill mobs one at a time until Ursal can be single pulled. Only killed 2 other mobs besides Ursal all single pulls. Ursal was a close fight but nothing bad. Sneak back out of camp and you're done.

To complete the quest you need to find and kill [b][npc=2039][/b].
This boi is a bit hard to find. There is a valley south of Darnassus entrance.
You need to go through the valley, there's a lake you will see. Keep moving south along the lake and further.
There is an area named Gnarlpine Hold. [b][npc=2039][/b] is near some kind of house. There are lots of mobs as well.
Clear the area carefully (really carefully) to avoid overpull. Kill the quest mob. Profit.
Keep in mind there are 11-12 lvl mobs, so you better be at least the same level.

Easy way As Rogue
1.Go to co-ords 38,80. As per picture. Stealth unless you want to kill 20/30 mobs to get to boss.3/4 at a time as they are very close.

2.Go to a tree 37,82 hanging off the cliff to the left of the boss. This is your starting point for attacks as the tree is out of their range and they break off attacks when you back onto the tree if for any strange reason things go wrong for you.

3.Use bow or distance weapon to kill 2 mobs near tree.

4.Kill 3 casters next to boss easily 1 or 2 at time.5.Pull boss to start of tree and kill. The enslaved druids then fly off task complete

Then stealth out or stone out(easier). Simple.

Giving directions is hard because ppl usually approach from different places...but here goes. Go to SW corner of Lake Al'Ameth by hugging NORTH shore of lake--killing the occaisional Timer-dude. As you near the end of the lake on the N side, look for a biiiig log laying down. Almost directly across from the log is a large, tall rock AT the waters edge. Jump on this rock, and look almost due South. You will see a path heading into more rocks. Cant miss it. (See that Oakenscowl's den is directly across the lake from you.). When you head into rocks, start looking on map for perfectly round crater/rock/hill type form on map. Ursal's camp is just behind it sort of right. Also, look for glowing purple tree..approach from this direction. There will be Gnarlpine camps on left and right. Ursal is toward the right but be careful. I killed some on left then went right but picked Ursal out before engaging others around him so not to get mobbed. If you kill them all, you'll get nice goodies...and, camp on left has trunk to pick with nice goodies to sell. I was NE Rogue lvl 14.10 going in. Draw them out and only once in a while is it 2 to 1...Good luck!

On the right as you're facing the entrance to the valley there's a bit of a path leading up that allows you to work up behind the Gnarlpine Hold.  It's before you really have to deal with the furbolgs, but slightly tricky since you eventually reach a point with the slope on the left and a tree to the right that requires jumping a few times to get up and through.  The advantage of this route is that it brings you down behind one of the huts in the main area - two mobs to kill there, another to the right you might aggro and you've got a clean line to pull Ursal as he roams.

I don't think you can get back out the way you came in, but hearthing out means you can do it with a total of 3-5 mobs and only one (unlinked) double-pull.

comments.body: Hey guys! Where and HOW do I get the coordinates of where I am?
replies: You need to download the add-on first.

Ok everyone,

You do NOT need an add-on to see coords. Create a macro (from the root menu, or just type /macro) and type or copy/paste this in:

/script px,py=GetPlayerMapPosition("player")
/script DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(format("[ %s ] %i , %i",GetZoneText(),px*100,py*100));

Then put the button on your actionbar. Coordinate problem solved, and you don't need to download/install anything.

NOTE: If you enter a new area and the button shows 0,0 as the coords, open/close the map and it'll fix the loc.
